Weld Test Report (Visual + NDT) 40 checkpoints across 6 sections.Every structural weld (shop fabrication and field assembly) must be inspected and tested. Inspection includes visual (100%), dimensional (100%), and NDT (percentage per project spec, typically 10-100% depending on criticality and code requirements). Download ExcelDownload PDF **40** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per weld joint (100% inspection; 100% visual, 100% dimensional, partial or full NDT per spec) Welding Inspector, QC Engineer [IS 822:1970](https://infralens.in/code/IS-822-1970) [IS 816:1969](https://infralens.in/code/IS-816-1969) [IS 4260:1989](https://infralens.in/code/IS-4260-1989) [IS 1182:1981](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1182-2014) [IS 5334:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-5334-1992) [IS 3658:1994](https://infralens.in/code/IS-3658-1994) Related [📐IS 822](https://infralens.in/code/IS-822) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Cube Test Acceptance Criter…](https://infralens.in/handbook/cube-test-acceptance) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. Joint Details & Welding Information | | A1 | Joint Identification & Location
Acceptance: Joint ID matches drawing, location on structure documented, drawing reference cited, coordinates recorded if applicable | IS 822:1970 Section 3 | OK
NC
NA | | A2 | Joint Type Verification
Acceptance: Joint type (Butt/Fillet/T-joint/Corner) matches drawing and WPS; Both parent metal surfaces identified | IS 822:1970, IS 816:1969 | OK
NC
NA | | A3 | Weld Process Compliance
Acceptance: Process (SMAW/GMAW/SAW/FCAW) matches WPS, correct electrode classification per IS 814, electrode diameter matches WPS | IS 822:1970 Section 3; IS 816:1969 | OK
NC
NA | | A4 | Welder Qualification
Acceptance: Welder ID documented, qualification certificate current and valid per IS 822 (typically 2-3 years), process/position qualified for joint type | IS 822:1970 Section 4 | OK
NC
NA | | A5 | Parent Metal Specifications
Acceptance: Parent metal grade (Fe 500D/E250/E350) documented, thickness measured and recorded, condition (as-received/stress-relieved) noted | IS 816:1969, IS 822:1970 | OK
NC
NA | | A6 | Filler Metal Specification
Acceptance: Electrode type and classification per IS 814 (e.g., ER70S-2 for GMAW), size matches WPS, batch/lot number recorded | IS 814:2016 (or applicable version) | OK
NC
NA | | A7 | WPS Reference & Validity
Acceptance: WPS Reference cited, WPS valid for joint configuration/materials/thickness, preheat/PWHT requirements from WPS followed | IS 822:1970 Section 5; IS 816:1969 | OK
NC
NA | | B. Visual Inspection (IS 822:1970) | | B1 | Weld Profile (Face)
Acceptance: Profile acceptable: flat (±1.5 mm) or slight convexity or slight concavity; no wavy/irregular surface; transition smooth to parent metal | IS 822:1970 Section 6 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B2 | Weld Face Width (Butt Joints)
Acceptance: Width measured at 3+ locations, variation ≤ 5 mm per IS 816 Table 9, no excessive build-up (reinforcement ≤ 3 mm above parent surface) | IS 816:1969 Table 9 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B3 | Reinforcement Height (Butt Joints)
Acceptance: Maximum reinforcement: 3 mm above parent metal surface; measured at 3+ locations | IS 816:1969 Section 6.2 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B4 | Throat Thickness (Fillet Joints)
Acceptance: Throat ≥ 0.7 × specified leg length (or 3 mm minimum); verified by visual profile or templates; adequate for static load | IS 816:1969 Section 6.3 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B5 | Leg Length (Fillet Joints)
Acceptance: Equal leg length (for equal fillet): ≥ specified dimension (e.g., 8 mm), measured perpendicular to weld face, uniform along length | IS 816:1969 Section 6.3 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B6 | Undercut Inspection
Acceptance: No undercut ≥ 0.5 mm depth or ≥ 50 mm cumulative length per side of butt; For fillet: none visible on toe | IS 816:1969 Table 9; IS 822:1970 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B7 | Porosity & Blowholes
Acceptance: No visible porosity clusters; isolated pores ≤ 1 mm diameter and ≤ 3 pores per 100 mm² acceptable; no steam holes or cracks at pores | IS 822:1970 Section 6 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B8 | Cracks & Cold Cracking
Acceptance: NO cracks permitted — not in weld, HAZ, or parent metal; any visible crack = REJECT | IS 822:1970 Section 6 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B9 | Overlap (For Fillet Welds)
Acceptance: NO overlap permitted; lap of parent metal over weld face is a defect = REJECT | IS 816:1969 Section 6.3 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B10 | Incomplete Fusion (Lack of Fusion)
Acceptance: No visible lack of fusion at weld toe or sidewalls; weld fully bonded to parent; any visible gap = REJECT | IS 822:1970 Section 6 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B11 | Crater Fill & End Quality
Acceptance: Craters at weld start/stop filled completely, no shrinkage cavity, smooth transition; for field welds, run-off/run-on tabs acceptable if removed cleanly | IS 822:1970 Section 6 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B12 | Spatter & Cleaning
Acceptance: Spatter removed, weld clean and free of flux residue (for SAW); no adherent slag; finish clean | IS 822:1970 Section 6 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | B13 | Visual Inspection Overall Verdict
Acceptance: All items ACCEPT = pass visual; any REJECT = fail visual, proceed to repair or rejection decision | All items B1-B12 | PASS
FAIL
NA | | C. Dimensional Verification | | C1 | Weld Length vs Drawing
Acceptance: Actual weld length matches drawing (±5 mm minimum acceptable unless drawing specifies tighter tolerance); continuous weld unbroken | IS 822:1970 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | C2 | Weld Size vs Drawing
Acceptance: For Fillet: leg length = specified size (±1 mm acceptable); For Butt: reinforcement within limits, throat adequate | IS 816:1969 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | C3 | Angular Distortion
Acceptance: Angular distortion ≤ 3° total on face side and root side combined; measured with straightedge or dial gauge over 500 mm span | IS 816:1969 Section 7.1 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | C4 | Linear Misalignment (Step)
Acceptance: For butt welds: misalignment ≤ lesser of (t/4 or 3 mm), where t = parent thickness; measured perpendicular to weld axis | IS 816:1969 Section 7.2 | ACCEPT
REJECT
NA | | C5 | Dimensional Check Verdict
Acceptance: All dimensional checks ACCEPT = pass; any REJECT requires evaluation for structural impact | All items C1-C4 | PASS
FAIL
